title: The Wooden Whistle and the Oil
youtube_title: The Wooden Whistle and the Oil | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Some good things arrive only when they are not poked.
summary: At a greenhouse bench with seed pots and a south window, Lior wants to check on a wooden whistle rubbed with oil that had to sink in before it is ready. With Auntie June nearby, Lior leaves it covered and does a quiet task instead, until it finishes in its own time.
